reference.unit: One canonical icons/*.json entry. Excludes aliases as independent icons, Lab, and package exports.

methodology.exact_name: Same canonical name, excluding known brand, orientation and shape/state differences. Does not certify artwork quality.
methodology.semantic_equivalent: Editorially reviewed alternate local name with the same principal intent. This report creates no API aliases. Every mapping is disclosed.
methodology.missing: No strong mapping established. Similar tags, categories and broad metaphors are insufficient.
methodology.categories: Recursively resolve Lucide $extends: categories; deduplicate in source order. First category provides disjoint totals only.
methodology.compatibility: Eight historical same-name differences are resolved by explicit new variants. Existing public names and their geometry remain unchanged.
methodology.limitations: Pinned semantic coverage is separate from visual quality and platform validation. Exact-name coverage is not evidence of upstream geometry or API compatibility. Logical text start/end mappings are LTR only.
